parsed.rationale: Sinus rhythm with a narrow QRS, deep S waves in V1–V3 and very tall R waves in V4–V6 (S in V2 plus R in V4/V5 is about 35 mm or more), with left axis deviation; the mild concave ST elevation in V1–V3 with upright T waves is the secondary repolarization pattern of LVH, not a convex ST elevation with reciprocal changes or Q waves, so it does not meet STEMI criteria and does not support the team's acute STEMI impression.
